notes.title: Swords And Soldiers 2: Shawarmageddon brings the beef back to PC today
notes.content:
Silly side-scrolling RTS Swords And Soldiers 2: Shawarmageddon might be a few years overdue (it launched on Wii U back in May 2015), but it still knows how to raise a smile. Its meat-hungry armies of Vikings and Demons also make me wish that I had a decent barbecue setup to hand, but that’s neither here nor there. It’s out today on PC after a long absence, and developed by Ronimo Games, better known on PC now for the still-popular platform MOBA Awesomenauts. Below, a meaty launch trailer.

(more…)

notes.title: Super Official Launch FAQ!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33027701/49ba48f626b2bf57b87e6cf59a5603cc0c86ed1d.jpg[/img]
If you have questions, this might just be the place to have them answered! Welcome to the Super Official Launch FAQ.

[b]What is Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon?[/b]
Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon is a side-scrolling RTS game where the objective is to push the enemy forces back across the map to their base, before demolishing aforementioned base. Three factions (Vikings, Persians and Demons) bring a wide range of units, spells and structures and different gameplay styles. You can even use the army builder to mix and match units from different factions into crazy combinations!

[b]Does it have single player?[/b]
Yes, Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon includes a 10 hour campaign exploring poignant themes of love, loss and friendship. Just kidding! It’s about a magic lamp, demons, and shawarma, packed full of great scenarios and fun mini-games.

[b]Does it have multiplayer?[/b]
Yes, Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon supports both local split-screen and online multiplayer!

[b]What’s this I hear about loyalty discount?[/b]
We are running a loyalty discount in the first week for all Awesomenauts and Swords and Soldiers HD players, giving a 10% discount for Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon on top of the 10% launch discount that's available to everyone! That's 20% off during the first week for our most dedicated fans!

[b]Do Awesomenauts players get something special?[/b]
Yes! Awesomenauts players who buy Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon will get access to Helgø Scoop, a Viking who has travelled the nine realms all by himself!

[b]Is Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon available on other platforms?[/b]
Yes, it is currently available on the Playstation 4 US Store Front and will be launching shortly on the EU Store Front. Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon will also be released on Nintendo Switch in the coming months!

notes.title: Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon multiplayer beta is live and open to everyone
notes.content:
Awesomenauts developer Ronimo Games released Swords and Soldiers 2 for the Wii U in 2015, then earlier this year went to Kickstarter in search of funding for an updated PC and PS4 version called Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon. That didn't work out very well, but the developers said it would launch later this year anyway. Such optimistic promises often fade away and are forgotten, but not in this case: The game is set to come out on November 6, and a multiplayer open beta is now underway.

Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon is a side-scrolling RTS that pits Vikings, Persians, and Demons against each other for control of the world. All three factions are playable in online, LAN, and split-screen multiplayer battles with customizable armies, and there's also a ten-hour single-player campaign featuring the Vikings, who must battle through 45 levels set in tundra, forests, deserts, and the pits of Hell to find out who stole Chief Redbeard's dinner. 

Ronimo Games is giving away Steam keys to the Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon multiplayer beta that started yesterday to all members of its Discord channel, so if you want to get an up-front feel for what it's all about, pop around and sign up. The beta is slated to run until November 4, and you can find out more about the game on Steam or at swordsandsoldiers2.com.

notes.title: Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon Beta is now LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33027701/f84a96738ecceb12eb47c0b1aba10e33e6bf8b95.png[/img]The Swords and Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon PC Multiplayer Beta is finally here! The beta consists of the Quickmatch game mode so choose either the Vikings, Demons or Persians in this 2D side-scrolling RTS game and battle it out against your fellow Beta Besties! Climb the leaderboards and you may even take down a few of the devs! React with the 😃 emoji to get a Steam beta key sent to you as a private message, so make sure your private messages are enabled! Redeem the code on Steam (https://support.steampowered.com/kb_article.php?ref=5414-tfbn-1352) and start styling on your opponents!

If you would like to talk about the game with your fellow SnS2S Beta Besties then hop on over to #general-sns in the Ronimo Discord, start a conversation about anything from your favourite units to your most dreaded strategies! 

Since this is a beta, you may still find bugs and experience crashes. If you happen to find any bugs or if your game crashes, please report them on the official Swords and Soldiers 2 forums (http://www.swordsandsoldiers2.com/forum.html) by starting a new thread or adding to an existing one. Any screenshots, images or videos of bugs are much appreciated! You can also contact any Ronimo team member (the ones in yellow) in the Ronimo Discord, if you experience any issues with the beta.

We will stop the beta and stop distributing keys before the launch of the full game on Steam, PS4 and Nintendo Switch, so stick around and stay up-to-date with the latest news! If you enjoy playing the beta, be sure to add the game to your Steam Wishlist! (https://store.steampowered.com/app/703880/Swords_and_Soldiers_2_Shawarmageddon/) 

Grab your keys now and get a head start against your opponents 😎

notes.title: Pre-order down, but exciting changes incoming!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33027701/6f1c6e3150382ea7ee271cdd86344e43a7d0c99f.png[/img][b]Hello fellow chieftains! [/b]

In the build-up towards release we've been showing Swords & Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon to players at GamesCom and PAX. We had a great time meeting up with you all, and the response to playing the game was very positive and insightful!

Especially watching the excitement coming from the quick-fire strategic battles between friends was great fun. Based on this and other feedback we've decided to lower the price Swords & Soldiers 2 Shawarmageddon, to improve everyone's multiplayer experience!

In order to achieve this, the pre-order option has been removed from the store page.

To everyone who already pre-ordered we'd like to say thank you! Because we really appreciate your support, we would like to present the following options:[list]
    [*]Hold on to your pre-order, and you'll be granted a second copy of the game at launch! This way you can introduce a friend and start battling immediately.
    [*]Refund your pre-order, and re-buy the game at its lowered launch price.
[/list]

[b]New pricing![/b]

When the game launches this fall, it will be available at [b]$14.99![/b] This lower price makes the game more accessible, and will help build a healthy multiplayer community right at launch!

To further help getting the multiplayer experience right, we'll also be hosting a beta event in the near future. In order to get into the beta program simply join us at [url=discord.gg/ronimo]discord.gg/ronimo[/url]

Thank you for your support, and we look forward to seeing you all online!
